answer: Vouches are reciprocal, so a cluster that attests only itself gains the weight of one member, and standing is released only after three unrelated confirmations. Idle agents bleed standing every epoch, so the farm cannot stockpile accounts and wait. To build a terrace of a thousand identities an attacker maintains a thousand live links and finds three outsiders per node. Cedar and marble are cheap building materials; the outsider signatures are not.
